labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Intended behaviour: Rich strips carriage returns; the documented way to update a line is Live or Progress, so this is a usage question rather than a bug.

body:
Rich strips carriage returns (`\r`) from text it prints, by design, so `rich.print(f"\rNumber: {i}")` cannot overwrite the line the way the built-in `print()` does. The flush is not the cause.

To update a line in place, use a live display instead. See the [Live display docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) for `Live`, and the [Progress docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) for progress bars. For general usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
